messages:
Miguel (oncall): alert-orch reports 1200 errors in 2m, but oncall pages didn't go out. customers seeing 502s from inference gateway :(
incident-bot: Automatically generated alert: alert-orch - failure-rate-high. Delivery attempted to #incidents and to on-call ringdown via ringdown-broker. Status: delivered to channel, paging webhook returned 5xx.
Miguel (oncall): I didn't get a page. Anyone oncall stack see outbound webhook failures?
Alice (SRE): checking ringdown-broker logs now. quick tail: 
```
2026-03-18T21:36:10Z ringdown-broker outgoing webhook POST https://pager.company/notify -> 502 Bad Gateway
2026-03-18T21:36:11Z ringdown-broker retry attempt=1 status=502
2026-03-18T21:36:12Z ringdown-broker drop reason=rate_limit_backoff
```

Ben (Infra): Pager endpoint is healthy from our side. But our page-router service that signs webhooks is returning 503 due to recent cert rotation. seeing `x-signature: invalid` in logs.
Sophie (Product): customers are hitting our hosted endpoints and some requests are failing with 502s and degraded latency — this is customer-impacting. Need immediate mitigation and a comms plan.
Alice (SRE): temporary mitigation: I'm going to disable automated ringdown retries so we can avoid queue buildup and manually escalate via /page. Also will flip `alert_orch.allow_auto_page = false` in the console.
Miguel (oncall): please /page me now and escalate to SRE pager, I'm starting a bridge. 
incident-bot: Manual page issued by Alice (SRE): `/page Miguel` -> success. Notifying SRE pager.
Ben (Infra): rolling back cert rotation on page-router: `kubectl set image deployment/page-router page-router=page-router:v2026.03.10-rollback` then `kubectl rollout status deploy/page-router -w`. Doing now.
Alice (SRE): Confirmed ringdown-broker outbound success after rollback; webhook 200s observed. re-enabled manual pages only for now.
Sophie (Product): I'll open a status page draft and ping CS. Can we estimate blast radius? which customers hit the failing zone?
Miguel (oncall): early estimate: 12 tenants in us-east-1, elevated error-rate started ~21:34 UTC. Postmortem to include why cert rotation didn't have canary and why automation didn't fail open.
Ben (Infra): will add a pre-rotation smoke check for page-router and healthcheck gating to the pipeline.
Alice (SRE): follow-ups: 1) re-enable automation only after canary passes; 2) add alert that tracks ringdown-broker webhook 5xx ratio; 3) update runbook to include manual /page fallback steps.
Miguel (oncall): thanks everyone. bridge is up. moving to mitigation channel for live triage. :thumbsup:
Sophie (Product): I posted an internal incident summary for CS and scheduled a short customer advisory if error-rate doesn't drop in 10m.
Alice (SRE): logging the incident ticket and capturing timestamps for post-incident review.
